context: Saito and Asuka receive a sudden news about an old colleague; emotional reaction.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: さいとう、信じられない、お知らせ。
lines.style: Soft intake of breath at the name. Tremor under control but visible in the pacing. Warm, honest delivery—this is not performance, this is a person who has been holding something and finally let it out.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.en: It really was like a miracle.
lines.style: Quiet, measured delivery grounded in years of seeing what medicine can and cannot do. A crack of genuine warmth on 'miracle'—this person believes in what she's saying. Breath steady but not cold.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 愛情、ようけ振ってもらった人やった。
lines.en: She was someone who had been given so much love.
lines.style: Speaking of someone no longer here. Reverent, gentle—not eulogy-formal but the care of someone choosing each word. Soft pause before 'love.' Voice stays tender, doesn't break.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 寂しい、気持ち、共感する。
lines.en: I understand that loneliness. I feel it too.
lines.style: Meeting the other person's grief without performance. Slow, deliberate pacing. The doctor's steadiness—she has sat with loss before. A small, genuine acknowledgment of shared feeling, not reassurance.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 熱い思い、伝えたかった。
lines.en: I wish I'd told her how much she meant to me.
lines.style: Quiet regret, carefully contained. A slight tremor on 'meant'—not breaking, but honest. The voice of someone who has thought about this many times and is saying it aloud for the first time to someone who understands.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 気付いた時に、すぐ会いに行こう。
lines.en: When you realize it, go see her right away.
lines.style: A small, firm conviction beneath the gentleness. Not a command—a promise between two people who understand. Slightly slower pace on 'right away.' The steady voice of someone who has learned not to delay.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: Yes. This time, I will. I promise.
lines.style: A quiet resolve. No hesitation, no trailing-off. The voice of someone who has just made a choice that matters and knows it. Warm, grounded, certain. Slight emphasis on 'will'—this time will be different.
